sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.9282 of 2023
Order:

This writ petition has been filed seeking to declare the action of the respondents in not extending the benefits under R&R package, even after lapse of 12 years, though the petitioner's house bearing H.No.527, admeasuring 596 square yards situated at Survey No.166, Singireddy Palli Village,
Kamanpur Mandal (erstwhile Karimnagar District), Peddapalli District, was acquired under acquisition proceedings No.(B1/1977/08) vide Award No.3/2010, dated 01.07.2010 as illegal,
arbitrary and contrary to the guidelines framed in G.O.Ms.No.68 dated 08.04.2005 and the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act and the National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy,
2007 and for other appropriate reliefs.

The petitioner claims to be the owner and possessor of house bearing No.526, admeasuring 596 square yards, in Survey No.166 situated at Singireddy Palli Village, Kamanpur Mandal (Erstwhile Karimnagar District) Now Peddapalli District.

The case of the petitioner is that in the year 2008, on the requisition of respondent No.6 for acquiring 137.05 guntas of CVBR, J Wp_9282_2023 land in Survey Nos.14, 15, 135, 136, 137, 165, 166, 167, 169, 670, 672, 673, 682, 683, 684, 685 situated in Singireddy Palli H/o Jallaram Village, Kamanpur Mandal, Karimnagar District, respondent No.3 herein issued a notification for acquisition of the said lands in the year 2009.

After hearing objections and after conducting award enquiry, respondent No.3 passed an award, vide Award No.3 of 2010 dated 01.07.2010, by mentioning the name of the petitioner along with others and compensation of Rs.16,56,066/- was also paid to him.

The grievance of the petitioner is that the respondents have acquired his house property vide Award No.3 of 2010 dated 01.07.2010 without extending the benefits under Rehabilitation and Resettlement Package and even though he submitted several representations on the file of the respondents seeking to extend the benefits under the Rehabilitation and Resettlement Package on par with other beneficiaries under the said award, till date, the respondents have not taken any action.
CVBR, J Wp_9282_2023
Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

This Court, without expressing any opinion on the entitlement of the petitioner, since it is stated that the petitioner has submitted several representations seeking to extend the benefits under Rehabilitation and Resettlement Package on par with other beneficiaries under the Award No.3 of 2010 dated 01.07.2010, duly enclosing all the relevant documents to substantiate his claim, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents to examine the same and pass appropriate Nadipelli Naveen Kumar Rao vs The State Of Telangana And 4 Others on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33269093/
1 reasoned orders thereon, in accordance with the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, within a period of three (3) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
